FrameWriteBuffer
Serializes HTTP/2 frames into a ByteWriter scratch buffer with the standard length-back-patching technique: FrameWriteBuffer.beginFrame(dev.relism.flash.http2.frame.FrameType, int, int) writes a 9-byte header with a placeholder length, the caller writes the payload directly through FrameWriteBuffer.writer() (the same ByteWriter), and FrameWriteBuffer.endFrame() rewrites the length once it is known — the payload size is rarely known before it is serialized (an HPACK-encoded header block, in particular, has no cheap way to be measured in advance).

Sse
A SseHandler at the given path.
SseEvent
One server-sent event and its optional standard metadata.

StandaloneNioDavHandler
A directory one process serves: the bytes in use, uploads in progress and locks live in its memory.
StaticFiles
Files read once from the classpath and served from memory: every byte a response carries, headers included, is prepared at boot, so serving allocates nothing.
Status
The gRPC status codes, in their wire order: ordinal() is the code.
Target
The resource a role is checked on: the values RolesAllowed.on() names, read from path and query parameters on HTTP and from tool arguments on MCP.
Template
The jte template a ViewHandler renders, relative to the template root.
Template
The Thymeleaf template a ViewHandler renders, without prefix or suffix.
TestSecurity
Authenticates test requests as any Principal, whatever mechanisms the application installs — an OIDC user, an API key, a plain name — without an identity provider.
TextContent
Plain-text content block (type: "text" on the wire).
TextResourceContents
Text resource contents returned from resources/read.
ThymeleafModule
Thymeleaf templates for ViewHandlers named with Template or Fragment, read from the classpath.
TlsConfig
Declarative TLS configuration for a ServerConfig.Listener.
TokenBucketStrategy
Token-bucket rate limit: tokens refill continuously at a rate of limit / windowMs tokens per millisecond, up to a maximum of limit tokens.
Tokens
Unguessable identifiers: session ids, sign-in state, PKCE verifiers, API key parts.
Tool

invalid reference 
McpConfig#toolsPackage(String)
.
ToolArg
Declares one input argument of a Tool.
ToolArgType
JSON Schema primitive types available for ToolArg.type().
ToolArguments
Typed accessor over a tools/call request's arguments object.
ToolResponse
Result of a McpTool.call(ToolArguments) invocation.
TRACE
A handler class that answers TRACE at the given path.
TransactionIsolation
 
TransactionPropagation
 
TransportFactory
Composes the transport: binds every configured listener, wires the connection runner and both protocols, and returns the ServerLifecycle that Server drives.
TransportLimits
Transport-level bound on concurrent connections, enforced by ConnectionRunner before any per-connection state (TLS handshake, protocol negotiation, HPACK tables, buffers) is set up.
Tx
Runs work in a transaction of one TxManager: commits when it returns, rolls back when it throws or was marked rollback-only.

Tx.TxRunnable
 
TxDefinition
 
TxException
 
TxManager
 
TxOutcome
 
TxResourceKey
A slot in the thread's transaction resources.
TxStatus
 
TxSynchronization
Lifecycle hooks for one transaction, registered through Data#afterCommit (or ResourceRegistry.addSynchronization(dev.relism.flash.ext.data.core.TxSynchronization) directly) and fired by the TxManager that owns the transaction they were registered in.
TypeArguments
The type arguments a handler class gives a generic base, resolved through every class between them: what a boot-time check or a document reads off a handler's signature.
Ui<S>

Redoc community edition, pinned to 2.x.
Ui.Scalar

Sidebar and content in two columns, or the one-column classic.

Ui.Scalar.Theme

Ui.Swagger
Swagger UI, pinned to 5.x.
Ui.Swagger.Expand
How much of the document is open when the page loads.
Ui.Swagger.Syntax
The highlighter's palette.
Undocumented
Keeps a route out of the published document.
UserResolver<U>
The application user a verified principal belongs to — typically found, or provisioned, by issuer and subject.
Validation
Verifies that a value satisfies the rules its own type declares.
ValidationException
Raised when a value breaks its rules.
ValidationException.Violation
One broken rule: where it was, and what it wanted.
Verb
Marks a routing annotation with the HTTP method it stands for.
ViewEngine
A template engine as ViewHandler uses it; one per app, added by its ViewModule.
ViewHandler
A handler that answers with a template: the engine's annotation names it, ViewHandler.render(dev.relism.flash.http.Request, dev.relism.flash.http.Response) fills it.
ViewModel
Mutable per-request model builder.
ViewModule
What every template engine module shares: values every template sees (ViewModule.global(java.lang.String, java.util.function.Function<dev.relism.flash.http.Request, java.lang.Object>)), and a boot-time check that a handler naming a template is a ViewHandler.
ViteModule
A Vite frontend for a Flash app.
WebSocketFrame
A zero-copy message view, valid only during onMessage.
WebSocketHandler
A bare WebSocket endpoint with one reused frame view per connection.

WebSocketSession
One accepted WebSocket connection.
WriteIntent
"Serialize yourself, then hand me the finished bytes."
Ws
A WebSocketHandler at the given path, over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 alike.
Xml
XML in and out, checked against the body type's own constraints.
XmlHandler<I,O>
A handler that reads XML and answers XML.
XmlModule
XML for an application: the Xml codec.
